name: synthetic-insufficient-funds
description: SYNTHETIC: the create is refused with 402 insufficient_funds — the connector's transcribe.so wallet (the ONE account every monid run bills) cannot hold the job. No job exists, nothing is held, so the run settles as zero-billed DATA with the vendor's status and its `{error: {code, message, request_id, doc_url}}` envelope verbatim, so the caller sees the vendor's own code. Envelope shape per utils/api-auth.ts apiError (2026-09-26).

error.message: Your wallet balance is too low to hold this job (needs $0.03). Top up at https://transcribe.so/billing. Docs: https://transcribe.so/developers/docs#insufficient_funds
